name: path-buttons
description: Coloured buttons and previews above the prompt for the paths in Claude's replies: left click opens (folders, media and text in the app of your choice), right click copies the path, hover shows the file name. Windows, macOS, Linux. /path-buttons opens the settings.

aliases.title: Short names for folders
aliases.description: Optional. name=folder in the project, separated by semicolons, e.g. shot01=blender/shots/shot01. Folders directly in the project are found without an entry.
